items.title: Magician Presenting a Nutcracker
items.alt: Grey-haired magician in a green coat presenting a wooden case with a crowned nutcracker inside.
items.description: The magician opens a tissue-lined wooden case toward the viewer. His long green coat and plum scarf frame the small crowned toy, which lies neatly inside the box.

items.title: Fairy and Nutcracker Music Box
items.alt: Lavender-and-gold music box topped by a winged fairy and green-jacketed nutcracker holding hands.
items.description: A winged fairy and crowned nutcracker turn together above a star-decorated oval base. The side winding key and scalloped gold trim identify the small music-box setting.

items.title: Nutcracker and Mouse King on a Checkered Stage
items.alt: Crowned nutcracker and grey Mouse King facing one another on a low checkered wooden stage.
items.description: Two crowned figures face each other with short batons lowered. The nutcracker's navy coat contrasts with the mouse's sweeping purple robe and long curved tail.

items.title: Snow Dancers with a Nutcracker
items.alt: Three ballet dancers in ice-blue, lilac and silver dresses arranged around a small red nutcracker.
items.description: Three dancers form an open group around a red toy on a cream plinth. Their different poses and light layered skirts are echoed by three small snowflake accents above.

items.title: Piano Practice with a Nutcracker
items.alt: Woman in a mustard blouse at a walnut upright piano with a small red nutcracker on top.
items.description: The pianist rests both hands on the keyboard while seated on a padded stool. A plain closed score and small red nutcracker sit together on the walnut piano top.

items.title: Nutcracker and Ballet Practice Bag
items.alt: Open sage dance bag with pink ballet slippers, a folded cream wrap top and blue nutcracker.
items.description: Loose slipper ribbons extend across the foreground of the open canvas bag. A blue wooden nutcracker stands on burgundy fabric beside the folded cream practice top.
